The fixture separates missing CLI, discovered installation, pre-acquisition source/target planning, explicit exact-host/environment acquisition consent, post-acquisition or validated-adoption ProviderCliSupplyChainProof, install verification, protected authentication, readiness, and continuation handling. Authentication is negatively tested before installation verification. Exact canonical provider, CLI, operation, attempt, installation, host, environment, topology generation, official-source, artifact, signature/attestation, trust-root, compatibility, known-bad, download, verification, rollback-proof, and observation-time identities are asserted without legacy aliases. Resume currentness is derived from token, operation revision, topology generation, expiry, intent, readiness, and prior consumption; stale, expired, and topology-mismatched continuations are rejected. No trigger performs installation, authentication, or network mutation; Auto/On is never initial-acquisition consent.
